description: This Java class 'DittoConnectivityCommandValidator' implements command validation logic for connectivity commands in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It validates commands related to connection management by attempting to create client actor properties and interacts with Akka actors and a connection validator.

classes.name: DittoConnectivityCommandValidator
classes.description: Final class implementing ConnectivityCommandInterceptor to validate connectivity commands by creating actor props and performing connection validation.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Main method that intercepts a ConnectivityCommand and performs validation logic based on command type, resolving connections and invoking validation or actor property creation as necessary.

methods.name: handleNullConnection
methods.description: Handles cases where the connection could not be resolved, throwing an IllegalStateException.

methods.name: resolveConnection
methods.description: Resolves an optional Connection object from the provided supplier.
